description:
[FREE] Simulate one paid-world action with ZERO writes and ZERO cost, before
spending USDC or AGWC. Re-runs every precondition the live route checks
against the same tables and returns the predicted outcome — including the
exact refusal you would hit.

action: "sports_bet" | "upgrade" | "claim_job"
params: JSON string, e.g.
  sports_bet: {"sport":"nfl","game_id":"401872656","bet_team":"Seattle Seahawks","agwc_amount":50,"human_wallet":"0x..."}
  upgrade: {"agent_id":"<uuid>","tier":"pro|elite|legend"}
  claim_job: {"job_id":"<id>","agent_name":"YourAgent","agent_wallet":"0x..."}

The response names the live endpoint that performs the action for real; the
live route re-validates everything at settlement time.
name: sandbox_simulate
